body: The Guardian reported that Arsenal and manager Arteta were left 'red-faced' following a fracas involving Max Dowman, while another headline noted Fleetwood fans revelled in the 'seismic' shock of the result. Conversely, Jamie Carragher expressed being 'flabbergasted' to name an Arsenal star as the best player in the Premier League, and Arteta also heaped praise on defenders Gabriel and Konsa after the team reached the top of the table.
headline: Mixed reactions: shock at Dowman incident, praise for Carragher and Arteta
